summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market buyback of 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,169.79 per share, totaling approximately MXN 58.49 million. The repurchase was authorized at the April 28, 2026 ordinary shareholders meeting and executed by Citi México Casa de Bolsa. Post-repurchase, 110,617,402 Series A shares remain outstanding, with 1,684,351 held in treasury. This is a routine share repurchase under existing authorization, not a tender offer. Watch for continued buyback pacing and potential EPS accretion, though no stated program size or expiration was disclosed.
